parallels.note: Jesus stretched out his hand, and touched him, saying, “I want to. Be made clean.” Immediately his leprosy was cleansed.
He stretched out his hand, and touched him, saying, “I want to. Be made clean.” Immediately the leprosy left him.

translations.web: Being moved with compassion, he stretched out his hand, and touched him, and said to him, “I want to. Be made clean.”
translations.bsb: Moved with compassion, Jesus reached out His hand and touched the man. “I am willing,” He said. “Be clean!”
translations.kjv: And Jesus, moved with compassion, put forth his hand, and touched him, and saith unto him, I will; be thou clean.
translations.asv: And being moved with compassion, he stretched forth his hand, and touched him, and saith unto him, I will; be thou made clean.
